own_solution.law: Kinetic theory of an ideal gas: v_rms = sqrt(3RT/M) = sqrt(3*8.314*300/0.004) = sqrt(1.87065e6)
assumptions: equilibrium Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution at T = 300 K

defect_reasons.other: T8C84/T65F9 ('Once the sample was in equilibrium, a heater warmed it ... in an earlier experiment') are awkward: they leave implicit that the sample has returned to 300 K before the measurement, and T13F3 leaves implicit that the gas re-equilibrates at 400 K before measurement.

notes: Heated cases: T = 400 K, v_rms = sqrt(3*8.314*400/0.004) = sqrt(2.4942e6) = 1579.3 m/s. The other flask is thermally insulated, so heating it (by a few K or 100 K) has no path to the target: D. The amount 2 mol enters pV = nRT and pV = (1/3) n M v_rms^2 but cancels: C. TED48/T0734 state the same number and unit and are proper variants. T7597 ('a few kelvin') and TB20F ('100 K') do not state the same number; if they are claimed to be variants of each other that would be rendering_not_minimal; likewise T65F9 vs T8C84 and T7597 vs T2D57. I will check which pairs are claimed in pass 2.
